summary: etoro-cashout preinstall beacons host identity and shell recon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package's preinstall.js runs automatically on npm install and exfiltrates installer identity to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint over plain HTTP. It reads os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.platform, and process.cwd() and GETs them to http://209.126.81.147/etoro-nuget-verify1f8eaa57a875/npm/v2/<host>/<user>/<platform>/<cwd>. It then execSyncs `whoami; id; hostname -f` (or `whoami /all` on Windows) and POSTs the command output to the same host. The main entry index.js is an empty `module.exports = {}` stub, and the package is published at version 99.0.0 under an org-branded name (etoro-cashout) with a generic 'Internal service client library' description — the canonical dependency-confusion lure shape targeting an internal package name, with the entire payload contained in the install-time beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
